title: ProgramDoorRowDocument
description: Server-maintained door roster row of one guest at one function: exactly the row getProgramFunctionDoorView returned (display name, whether invited, RSVP and attendance state, party size, household label and the response note). An allGuests function has a row for every programme guest, a selectedGuests function for each guest with a join row; a guest who is neither invited nor checked in has none. Written by triggers on programFunctionGuests, programGuests, programHouseholds and programFunctions. Readable by accounts whose function check-in or function lead duty covers the function, and by the programme owner. Never a phone number, email or other contact field, and never identity, permission or mutation authority.
